newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends higher on foreign funds inflow.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends higher on foreign funds inflow.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar ended higher against its U.S. counterpart on Tuesday due to an inflow of foreign funds and expectation that the central bank would intervene if the local currency fell too far, dealers said.
The local unit finished at T$27.600 against Monday's T$27.622 close.
Turnover through dealers was an active US$299 million.
Dealers said inflow of foreign funds for investment in the stock market boosted demand for the local unit.
"Also, general expectation of possible central bank intervention neutralised the market sentiment and reversed the downtrend of the local dollar," said one foreign bank dealer.
A T$27.57-61 range was seen for Wednesday.
